item.title: Basics
item.description:
This lab explores the basic techniques for observing the state of Kubernetes using metrics.

In this lab, you will learn how to:

    ☐ Access metrics information produced by each cAdvisor in each Kubelet
    ☐ Inspect resources using the Resource Metrics API
    ☐ View metrics reported by Metrics Server
